debug.docs:
**mapping**: Options for debugging communication on the UART hub, see [Debugging](https://esphome.io/components/uart#debugging).

*See also: [Nordic UART Service (NUS)](https://esphome.io/components/ble_nus#configuration-variables)*

rx_buffer_size.docs:
**int**: Size of the receive buffer in bytes. Range: 160-8192. Defaults to `512`. Valid only for mode `uart`.

*See also: [Nordic UART Service (NUS)](https://esphome.io/components/ble_nus#configuration-variables)*

tx_buffer_size.docs:
**int**: Size of the transmit buffer in bytes. Range: 160-8192. Defaults to `512`.

*See also: [Nordic UART Service (NUS)](https://esphome.io/components/ble_nus#configuration-variables)*

type.docs:
**string**: Mode of operation. One of `logs` or `uart`. `logs` streams ESPHome logs. `uart` provides bi-directional communication. Defaults to `logs`.

*See also: [Nordic UART Service (NUS)](https://esphome.io/components/ble_nus#configuration-variables)*
